cards.lesson: The executable failure is preserved as a conditional debug observation: candidate_stage_failed. The next candidate must repair the observed contract or runtime issue and still pass fresh-process reload plus Host recomputation before any score is compared.

cards.limits: Single-run conditional observations, not a universal optimum or model ban. Tune and host search have different roles. Review allegations are not runtime findings. evidence.action: Complete candidate: lazy image decoding with a compact torchvision ResNet18 backbone, multilabel BCE training, convergence-aware validation, tune-only global threshold selection over 0.02..0.50, argmax fallback, and self-contained artifact reload.

Implemented a self-contained lazy-decoding multilabel image candidate using a compact CNN trained with BCEWithLogitsLoss, convergence-aware validation, tune-only global threshold calibration over 0.02..0.50, argmax fallback for empty rows, deterministic artifact reload, and no pretrained or external assets.

Replace the compact plain CNN with a residual convolutional backbone using stronger spatial feature extraction, 160px inputs, cosine learning-rate decay, class-balanced BCE, deterministic validation trajectory, and the same tune-only global threshold calibration and argmax fallback. The candidate remains image-only, lazily decodes paths from /data, saves a self-contained state dict and metadata, and reloads identically.

Replace the prior compact-CNN baseline with a self-contained residual image model, retaining lazy image decoding, tune-only early stopping and global threshold calibration. The implementation avoids external/pretrained weights, handles dense or scipy-sparse NPZ labels without flattening, saves exact preprocessing/model metadata, and records the actual tune trajectory and selected threshold.

Keep the self-contained SmallResNet baseline and make model selection target-aligned: checkpoint and early-stop on tune micro-F1 after tune-only global threshold calibration, rather than on unweighted tune BCE. This preserves the image pipeline and training objective while selecting the trained epoch for the Host metric. The candidate records the actual convergence trajectory, selected epoch, threshold, seed, and optimizer settings in its artifact metadata.
